name: Lamu
blurb: Conversation about Lamu is up 235% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
Easy to get around without a car
negative: Some report crowding at peak times
Prices noticeably up on last season

quotes.text: Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
Second time here and it still feels underrated.
